sundai:fc:331.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:331.question: His _____ to become a doctor started when he was a child.
sundai:fc:331.fullSentence: His aspiration to become a doctor started when he was a child.
sundai:fc:331.explanation: aspiration: 熱望。expire: 期限が切れる。perspire: 汗をかく。

sundai:fc:332.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:332.question: This coupon will _____ at the end of this month.
sundai:fc:332.fullSentence: This coupon will expire at the end of this month.

sundai:fc:333.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:333.question: There has been a _____ increase in traffic accidents this year.
sundai:fc:333.fullSentence: There has been a significant increase in traffic accidents this year.

sundai:fc:334.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:334.hint: emotional(感情的な)の対義語に近い
sundai:fc:334.question: 「合理的な」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:334.fullSentence: We need to make a rational decision, not an emotional one.
sundai:fc:334.explanation: rational: 合理的な。emotional: 感情的な。

sundai:fc:335.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:335.question: He always shows _____ pride when the national anthem plays.
sundai:fc:335.fullSentence: He always shows patriotic pride when the national anthem plays.
sundai:fc:335.explanation: patriotic: 愛国的な。expatriate: 国外居住者。

sundai:fc:336.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:336.question: The millionaire threw a _____ party for his birthday.
sundai:fc:336.fullSentence: The millionaire threw a lavish party for his birthday.
sundai:fc:336.explanation: lavish: 気前の良い、豪華な。lavatory: トイレ。

sundai:fc:337.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:337.question: The stadium was _____; it could hold 80,000 people.
sundai:fc:337.fullSentence: The stadium was enormous; it could hold 80,000 people.

sundai:fc:338.question: Farmers use _____ to protect crops from insects.
sundai:fc:338.fullSentence: Farmers use pesticide to protect crops from insects.
sundai:fc:338.explanation: pesticide: 殺虫剤。cide「切る、殺す」語根。

sundai:fc:339.question: 「大量虐殺」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:339.fullSentence: The genocide shocked the entire world.
sundai:fc:339.explanation: genocide: 大量虐殺。homicide: 殺人。suicide: 自殺。

sundai:fc:340.question: Please give me a _____ answer, not a vague one.
sundai:fc:340.fullSentence: Please give me a precise answer, not a vague one.
sundai:fc:340.explanation: precise: 正確な。concise: 簡潔な。

sundai:fc:341.question: Please keep your summary _____ and to the point.
sundai:fc:341.fullSentence: Please keep your summary concise and to the point.

sundai:fc:342.question: He was too _____ to speak up in front of the crowd.
sundai:fc:342.fullSentence: He was too much of a coward to speak up in front of the crowd.

sundai:fc:343.question: Climate change poses a serious _____ to our planet.
sundai:fc:343.fullSentence: Climate change poses a serious menace to our planet.

sundai:fc:344.question: The dollar is the world's most widely used _____.
sundai:fc:344.fullSentence: The dollar is the world's most widely used currency.

sundai:fc:345.question: This illness tends to _____ every winter.
sundai:fc:345.fullSentence: This illness tends to recur every winter.

sundai:fc:346.question: 「差し迫った」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:346.fullSentence: War seemed imminent as tensions rose.
sundai:fc:346.explanation: imminent: 差し迫った。eminent: 著名な。

sundai:fc:347.question: Many countries have called for the _____ of the death penalty.
sundai:fc:347.fullSentence: Many countries have called for the abolition of the death penalty.
sundai:fc:347.explanation: abolition: 廃止。abolish: 廃止する。

sundai:fc:348.question: He chose to _____ from voting on the controversial issue.
sundai:fc:348.fullSentence: He chose to abstain from voting on the controversial issue.
sundai:fc:348.explanation: abstain (from): 棄権する。abstention: 棄権。

sundai:fc:349.question: The company was accused of _____ its power over employees.
sundai:fc:349.fullSentence: The company was accused of abusing its power over employees.

sundai:fc:350.question: The painting was very _____; it didn't look like anything real.
sundai:fc:350.fullSentence: The painting was very abstract; it didn't look like anything real.

sundai:fc:351.question: I _____ refuse to accept such unfair treatment.
sundai:fc:351.fullSentence: I absolutely refuse to accept such unfair treatment.

sundai:fc:352.question: The whole town gathered to _____ the loss of their beloved teacher.
sundai:fc:352.fullSentence: The whole town gathered to mourn the loss of their beloved teacher.

sundai:fc:353.question: The results clearly _____ that the new drug is effective.
sundai:fc:353.fullSentence: The results clearly demonstrate that the new drug is effective.

sundai:fc:354.question: I didn't _____ his name during the conversation.
sundai:fc:354.fullSentence: I didn't mention his name during the conversation.

sundai:fc:355.question: Nurses _____ patients' vital signs throughout the night.
sundai:fc:355.fullSentence: Nurses monitor patients' vital signs throughout the night.
